content.text: Hi everyone - I wanted to give you a heads up that we have requested a season credential for you that will be good for both Summer Camp and 2020 regular season games at Comerica Park. Even though you’ll have a season credential, we will still need for your sports editor to go on the credential system and request a daily credential for you for any workout or game that you plan to attend. This will help us with our daily numbers and making sure that we do not go over the cap of media that we are permitted to allow into the park on a daily basis. If you travel to any road games during the season, you will also have to apply for a credential with the road team through the credential site as well. If you have any questions, please let me know.
